h1: Nomads Ao Nang — Krabi's top party hostel, with its own foam-party pool
intro: If you're arriving in Krabi solo and want to make friends by your first night, Nomads Ao Nang is the name almost everyone in the backpacker scene brings up — a social hostel that has swept Hostelworld titles including Best Hostel In Thailand and Most Popular Hostel In Krabi. The clear draw is its own large outdoor pool that hosts foam parties and DJ nights, plus a bar with events every night. Dorms are air-conditioned with privacy curtains and lockers, and it welcomes guests aged 18–35 only · from approx. ฿150/bed (rising in high season) — 9.6 from 3,342 Hostelworld reviews.

body.html: Nomads Ao Nang is a party hostel from the Nomads group, set in the Ao Nang area of Mueang Krabi, about 700 m from Nopparat Thara Beach. What sets it apart from a typical hostel is its own large outdoor pool that hosts foam parties and DJ nights — not just a place to cool off, but the hub of activity all day. Reviews agree this is the kind of place where you arrive alone and have a crew within a few hours, thanks to nightly events and a team that makes a point of pulling everyone into the group.

Rooms are all air-conditioned dorms, in both a 6-bed layout with an ensuite bathroom and an 8-bed layout. A consistent point of praise is the beds, which have privacy curtains, a reading light, a power socket and a lockable cupboard for every bed — details many hostels at the same price still skip. Plenty of reviews say the beds are comfortable and the rooms cleaner than you'd expect for a party hostel. There are lockers for valuables, but it's worth bringing your own padlock just in case.
"Came alone and never felt lonely — island tour with the group in the morning, the pool in the afternoon, an event at the bar at night, and the curtained beds were comfier than I expected."

The common areas centre on a bar with nightly events — games, pub crawls and poolside parties. A detail many guests appreciate is that the music stops at 11pm, so anyone wanting to be up for a morning tour can still sleep — a balance plenty of party hostels never strike. The tour desk sells 4-island, Hong Island, Phi Phi and diving trips that are easy to book and leave with friends from the hostel. There's a garden, free parking and a kitchen/common space, but no breakfast and no airport transfer.

The thing to be clear about before you book is that this is a full-on party hostel, not a quiet stay. It welcomes guests aged 18–35 only, and as a licensed entertainment venue it doesn't allow outside alcohol. Some reviews complain the team pushes drinks and tours fairly hard, that tour-guide quality is inconsistent, and that a few cases of complaint or refund handling fell short. If you're after a quiet trip, travelling with family, or want privacy — this isn't the one.

The location is in Ao Nang, about 700 m from Nopparat Thara Beach and walkable to Ao Nang Beach and restaurants · it's roughly 30 minutes by car from Krabi Town and Krabi Airport (KBV). TripAdvisor gives it 4.2/5 with a Travelers' Choice award, and 9.6 from 3,342 Hostelworld reviews makes clear how much its target crowd loves it. In short, Nomads Ao Nang does the job of a party hostel for 18–35 solo travellers who want to meet people and have fun about as well as anywhere in Krabi · if that's what you're after, from approx. ฿150/bed is great value.

honestSummary: Nomads Ao Nang is one of Krabi's best party hostels for 18–35 solo travellers who want to meet people and have fun — the foam-party pool, nightly bar events and a team that gets you into the group fast are what guests remember · but you have to accept the night-time noise, the fairly hard push on drinks and tours, the 18–35 age rule and the no-outside-alcohol policy — this is not a stay for a quiet trip or for families.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Nomads Ao Nang

faq.q: Where is Nomads Ao Nang · can you walk to the beach?
faq.a: It's at 155 Ao Nang in the Ao Nang area of Mueang Krabi · about 700 m (~9 min walk) to Nopparat Thara Beach · roughly 1.8 km from the main Ao Nang Beach and 2 km from the Ao Nang pier · about 30 minutes by car from Krabi Airport (KBV) · you can walk to a beach and restaurants, though the main Ao Nang Beach is a short walk or drive away.

faq.q: How much does Nomads Ao Nang cost · what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿150/bed for a bed in the 8-bed AC dorm · there's also a 6-bed AC dorm with an ensuite bathroom from around ฿250/bed · every bed has a privacy curtain, reading light, power socket and a locker · prices depend on dates and climb quickly in high season, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: What ages does Nomads Ao Nang accept · what are the rules?
faq.a: It welcomes guests aged 18–35 only, and as a licensed entertainment venue it doesn't allow outside alcohol · it's a party hostel with events every night, but the music stops at 11pm so anyone wanting to be up for a morning tour can still sleep.

faq.q: Who is Nomads Ao Nang best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for 18–35 solo travellers who want to meet people and have fun · there's a foam-party pool, nightly bar events and island tours you leave on with friends from the hostel · it's not suited to those after a quiet trip, privacy, or travelling with family and kids.

faq.q: Does Nomads Ao Nang have breakfast or an airport transfer?
faq.a: There's no breakfast and no airport transfer · but there is a kitchen/common space, a garden, free parking and a tour desk that books 4-island, Hong Island, Phi Phi and diving trips · restaurants are within walking distance, so eating out is easy.

faq.q: Is Nomads Ao Nang noisy · can you sleep there?
faq.a: It's a party hostel, so there's noise from the nightly events, but the upside is that the music stops at 11pm · many reviews say they still slept and made morning tours · if you're a light sleeper or want real quiet, it may not suit you and a quieter Ao Nang stay would be better.
